method: Opened Tabelas de Vendas and Books dos Lançamentos from the Linktree buttons in the same public browser session without login.
Scrolled both virtualized roots to the end and visited all 82 root folders and three subfolders; reconciled every displayed folder count against 140 table and 132 Book paths.
Read every ZIP member to EOF for CRC and compared SHA-256 for all 272 PDFs.
Visually inspected all pages of the nine new source tables; replaced eight current Drive tables in place and re-downloaded every replacement for SHA-256 verification.
Read the full current coordinate sheet twice; matched 80 numeric pairs, Solo owner point and the owner-confirmed Baume catalog exception.

drive.verificationScope: All 220 referenced Drive files: fresh metadata and anyone/reader permission; all 82 map folders fully listed; all 89 table sizes matched to current source. Every replacement was re-downloaded and SHA-256 verified. Unchanged Drive books were not downloaded again.

commercialDateWarnings.up-icarai: The PDF prints validity through 31/11/2026, an impossible date. No issue date or corrected expiry was inferred; filename month retained separately and visible catalog warning added.

downloadRecovery.browserDownloadEvents: Several waitForEvent calls timed out; success was counted only after actual ZIP arrival, complete CRC reads and exact UI-path reconciliation.

limitations: Counts verified from published source data and deployment checks; the password-protected interior is not visually inspected without an authenticated session.

publication.verification: Deployment checks are attached to the audit commit; the final response reports the observed publication outcome.
